learn.summary: A resistor limits the current in a circuit. Its value is in ohms (Ω).
learn.formula: V = I × R   P = I² × R
tips: Read the colour bands from the end with no gap: 2 digits, the multiplier, then the tolerance.
This part is rated 0.25 W. More power makes it overheat.
A resistor has no polarity. You can connect it either way.
